comparison_scope.task: Produce one year-keyed view from already captured NOAA GML global CO2 (ppm) and CH4 (ppb) source-surface comparator outputs while retaining independent units and source receipts.
comparison_scope.environment: Local Python standard library; supplied JSON on stdin; no network, credentials, billing, or file reads during invocation.
comparison_scope.same_task_baseline: No existing registered operation or candidate has an input contract accepting both complete NOAA gas-specific comparator outputs and emitting separate per-gas rows with both source receipts.

findings: The CO2 comparator produces only the CO2 page/raw comparison and the CH4 comparator produces only the CH4 page/raw comparison; neither alone satisfies the paired-output contract.
The two comparators remain complementary inputs and are not replaced. The pairer does not retrieve either source and does not rank, convert, sum, divide, or otherwise combine the gases' values.

One controlled real-artifact run demonstrates the year-key transform and retained receipts. It does not establish comparative correctness against a maintained manual alternative, lower cost, reliability, or scientific usefulness; those remain COMPARISON_UNKNOWN.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Create a same-year table for CO2 and CH4 comparator captures while preserving ppm/ppb as separate quantities and exposing the nonzero capture-time span.
claim_ceiling: Task-fit and functional evidence for a bounded offline transformation only; not a comparison of scientific validity or provider accuracy.
